source.title: The Total Economic Impact of Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE Indirect Tax
source.how_opened: PDF downloaded and text-extracted; table 'Reduction In Annual Error Impact' (Ref A1-A15, At, Atr), p.11
source.caveat: Forrester Total Economic Impact study, commissioned by the vendor (vendor-favourable by design)

mapping_notes: Unusual unit mapping: the 'record' is one dollar of tax under management ($774,000,000 = $5.0 billion x 15.48%), and one erroneous dollar costs $1. This only exists to exercise the rate path (records x rate x cost); it is not a natural data-quality case.
Error rate after reconciliation = 3% x (1 - 90% reconciliation success) = 0.3%; error_rate_after = 0 (the study assumes errors are eliminated when invoices run through the tax engine).

PARTIAL: the published benefit also includes $194,400 of reconciliation effort (A11, internal $64,800 + outsourced $129,600), which is a cost saving, not an error-rate effect. The test adds 194,400 x adoption x (1 - 15%) outside the engine; only the error-impact part (A13 = $2,322,000) goes through the engine.
